claims.text: Passport Seva says an applicant should use the fresh category for an ordinary passport when the applicant has not previously held an ordinary passport.
claims.notes: Published general route; not a personal eligibility decision.

claims.text: The official application-instruction booklet's adult ordinary-citizen-by-birth normal-application row lists address proof and date-of-birth proof, with Non-ECR documentation only if the applicant is eligible for Non-ECR.
claims.notes: The published row is limited to its stated ordinary-citizen-by-birth case; case-specific Document Advisor selection was not attempted.

claims.text: Passport Seva's fresh-passport Document Advisor says applicants must furnish original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies at the Passport Seva Kendra for processing.
claims.notes: No document selection, upload, or case-specific determination was attempted.

claims.text: The official application-instruction booklet lists Rs. 1,500 as the normal fee for a 36-page ordinary fresh passport with ten-year validity in India.
claims.notes: The current public portal announces fee revision effective 1 July 2026; confirm the live fee calculator before paying. No payment or calculation was performed.

claims.text: The Regional Passport Office Bengaluru page says applicants will not be serviced at PSK or POPSK without a prior online appointment.
claims.notes: No appointment availability was queried or booked.

claims.text: Passport Seva says the Passport Office decides whether police verification is required for a fresh or re-issue application and says pre-passport verification is required in most cases.
claims.notes: This does not establish the verification mode for any individual applicant.

claims.text: The official application-instruction booklet says that for a normal application requiring pre-passport police verification, the passport is expected to be dispatched within three working days of the Passport Office receiving a recommendatory police verification report, excluding the report-receipt date.
claims.notes: Not a promise for appointment, police-visit, or end-to-end duration; booklet conditions dispatch on system checks and no adverse entry/report.

claims.text: Passport Seva's police-verification FAQ says an applicant who has not received a passport after six months while police verification is pending should visit the concerned Passport Office.
claims.notes: This was the actually encountered predeclared branch; no case-data lookup was attempted.

claims.text: The Regional Passport Office Bengaluru page identifies the office as Regional Passport Office Bengaluru and gives its Bengaluru location.
claims.notes: The page is an RPO office page, not confirmation of the particular PSK for an applicant.

claims.text: The public Passport Seva home page identifies the Ministry of External Affairs and exposes Login and Register handoffs to services1.passportindia.gov.in, along with Quick Links labelled Apply For Passport, Check Appointment Availability, Track Passport Application, and Register Feedback / Grievance.
claims.notes: Direct current observation of the public official interface; the quick-link destination routes were not opened from this page.

claims.text: The public fresh/reissue ordinary-passport guidance instructs an applicant to register, confirm the registered email ID, and then log in to the Passport Seva Online Portal with the registered Login ID and Password; it also says the password expires every three months.
claims.notes: Records the guide's visible instructions only. Registration and login were not attempted.

claims.text: The public PreLogin page displays a Login ID field, a Continue control, a Having Trouble Logging in? surface, and a Register here path, and warns applicants to remember their Login ID and not share credentials with unauthorized persons.
claims.notes: No Login ID was entered and Continue was not selected. No CAPTCHA was visible at this initial screen.

claims.text: The public fresh-passport guide calls RPO selection a prerequisite, says to select the RPO based on the current residing location, and says the selected RPO will reflect the nearest Passport Seva Kendra during appointment scheduling; it also states that applicants may apply at any PSK/RPO across India based on preference.
claims.notes: The public guide does not expose a Bengaluru-specific selection result without proceeding into registration/login, which was not attempted.

claims.text: The public fresh-passport guide lists nine sections from Passport Type through Details Verification and says that submitting the completed application generates a unique Application Reference Number and that an application can be saved and resumed before submission.
claims.notes: This pass did not create an application or obtain an ARN; the statement describes visible public guidance only.

claims.text: The public fresh-passport guide says that payment of the applicable passport service fee is mandatory before booking appointments in all Passport Seva Kendras, and describes selecting Normal or Tatkaal quota, selecting a PSK/POPSK, seeing the next available appointment date, and being redirected to a payment gateway after Pay and Book Appointment.
claims.notes: No payment, appointment availability lookup, booking, rescheduling, or gateway was opened. The exact fee and Bengaluru appointment availability remain outside this handoff.

claims.text: The public fresh-passport guide says that, after successful payment, the portal displays appointment confirmation details, sends appointment-date details by SMS to the registered mobile number, and instructs the user to carry necessary documents on the PSK visit date.
claims.notes: No SMS, appointment confirmation, document upload, or PSK visit was tested.

claims.text: Although the public home page visibly labels a Track Passport Application quick link, this pass did not open it or enter an ARN, file number, date of birth, CAPTCHA, or other case data; tracking inputs, validation, error messages, and recovery are Unknown.
claims.notes: The route was deliberately not opened because case tracking is outside the no-case-data safety boundary. This is not a researchedNoSourceFound marker.

claims.text: One Bengaluru Tatkal applicant reported that a PSK official did not accept the applicant's digital education-record access and referred the case to the regional passport office after the applicant lacked a physical education document.
claims.notes: A single account of a Tatkal document-objection and referral. It does not establish an ordinary-passport document requirement, treatment of digital records, referral rule, or recovery route.

claims.text: The same Tatkal applicant reported that a later public appointment view did not offer an early regional-passport-office slot for their referred case.
claims.notes: The account reports what the applicant saw for one referred Tatkal case in 2025. It does not establish current RPO appointment availability, eligibility for follow-up, or a normal-passport delay.

claims.text: One Bengaluru Tatkal applicant reported that the case remained pending after a police-verification interaction and that, after the applicant raised the matter publicly, the applicant observed a later approval and dispatch update.
claims.notes: This is one applicant's reported sequence and does not show why the case remained pending, whether the reported public escalation caused the change, or that this is a safe or generally effective remedy. It is not evidence for ordinary fresh adult passports.

roadblocks.title: Police verification remains pending

roadblocks.recovery: Use the visible Register here or Having Trouble Logging in? public surfaces; do not provide credentials or submit an application through this research pass.
